question: A 36-year-old woman comes to the physician to discuss contraceptive options. She is currently sexually active with one male partner, and they have not been using any contraception. She has no significant past medical history and takes no medications. She has smoked one pack of cigarettes daily for 15 years. She is allergic to latex and copper. A urine pregnancy test is negative. Which of the following contraceptive methods is contraindicated in this patient?
analysis: Considering the patient's history of latex allergy and copper allergy, the contraceptive method contraindicated in this patient would be the intrauterine device (IUD) as most IUDs contain copper and are inserted using devices made of latex.
